correctness.rationale: The bipartition cover inequalities exclude four guards and hence fewer by monotonicity. Two selected points in a five-set must share their vertical fiber, in which case the selected lines are the pencil through the omitted point; incidence duality gives the other five-sets. The displayed affine maps preserve edges; F and G generate an order-nine subgroup regular on each class, D interchanges classes and normalizes it, and DGD=G^-1 shows the extending group is nonabelian. Independent exhaustive enumeration using the affine adjacency and collision-free guard assignments found dominating-subset counts 0,18,423 for sizes 4,5,6, with 234 ordered legal five-state shifts and exactly one undefendable unoccupied vertex per five-set, all distinct. It reproduced 72,891 ordered six-state shifts and all 5,076 state/attack pairs, each with 25–81 distinct dominating destinations containing the attack target. Each source of a response can be reused indefinitely because the class of all dominating six-sets is closed under existence of a response to every attack. The 25–81 bounds are per source and attack, not per source alone. In the explicit five-set form the omitted point is fatal: a point-minority target containing it would need three entirely new lines but there are only two old point guards; a point-majority target would put its three points on a line through the attack, and both old point guards would be needed for the two new lines, leaving at most one other point of that target line reachable from the original pencil. Duality handles the other class.
residual_risks: The certificate is exhaustive for the specified 18-vertex affine incidence graph and simultaneous one-edge model, not for any class of graphs or other movement rules. It counts unlabeled guards on labeled vertices, not distinct guard assignments.

value.rationale: The degree-three Cayley structure is a motivated boundary for the failed Cayley equality. Beyond computing two invariants, the exact winning-state and response classification distinguishes existence of a strategy from robustness to every minimum-size winning-class placement, with a sharp obstruction at the immediately lower size. These are independently useful features of a natural symmetric graph, not a tiny unmotivated sample.
residual_risks: The value assessment is for the configuration-level result, not recomputing known ordinary domination or claiming that Pappus is a smallest counterexample.
